content: परिजल्पितम् A covert indication (as by a servant) of oneʼs own skill, superiority <ab>&c.</ab> by pointing out the cruelty, deceitfulness and such other faults of his master; <ls>Ujjvalamaṇi</ls> thus defines it:-- प्रभोर्निर्दयताशाठ्यचापलाद्युपपादनात् . स्वविचक्षणताव्यक्तिर्भङ्ग्या स्यात् परिजल्पितम् .. (<ls>Wilson</ls> renders the word by ‘the covert reproaches of a mistress neglected or ill-used by her lover’.)
